```{r}
OUT_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/MOFA2/Updated"

RDS_DIR <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "MOFA2_RDS")
TABLE_DIR <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "MOFA2_Tables")
MODEL_DIR <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "MOFA2_Model")
PLOT_DIR <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "MOFA2_Plots")

dir.create(RDS_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(TABLE_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(MODEL_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

PREPARED_VIEW_MATRIX_FILE <- file.path(
  RDS_DIR,
  "MOFA2_prepared_input_view_matrices.rds"
)

MODEL_OUTFILE <- file.path(
  MODEL_DIR,
  "MOFA2_updated_OncoKB_filtered_model.hdf5"

TRAINED_MODEL_RDS <- file.path(

```

```{r}
view_mats <- readRDS(PREPARED_VIEW_MATRIX_FILE)

expected_views <- c(
  "RNA_VST_top5000var",
  "WES_CNV_numeric",
  "WES_mutation_recurrent",
  "IMPACT_mutation_OncoKB"
)

missing_views <- setdiff(expected_views, names(view_mats))

view_mats <- view_mats[expected_views]

view_mats <- view_mats[
  sapply(view_mats, function(x) {
    is.matrix(x) && nrow(x) > 0 && ncol(x) > 0
  })
]

names(view_mats)
```
```{r}
# Summarize input views

view_summary <- rbindlist(lapply(names(view_mats), function(v) {
  mat <- view_mats[[v]]

  data.table(
    view = v,
    n_features = nrow(mat),
    n_samples = ncol(mat),
    n_non_missing_values = sum(is.finite(mat)),
    n_missing_values = sum(!is.finite(mat))
  )
}))

view_summary

fwrite(
  view_summary,
  file.path(TABLE_DIR, "MOFA2_training_input_view_summary.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
```

```{r sample-view-presence}
sample_view_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(names(view_mats), function(v) {
  data.table(
    sample = colnames(view_mats[[v]]),
    view = v,
    present = 1
  )
}))

sample_summary <- dcast(
  sample_view_dt,
  sample ~ view,
  value.var = "present",
  fill = 0
)

view_cols <- setdiff(colnames(sample_summary), "sample")

sample_summary[
  ,
  n_views_present := rowSums(.SD),
  .SDcols = view_cols
]

sample_summary <- sample_summary[
  order(-n_views_present, sample)
]

sample_summary

fwrite(
  sample_summary,
  file.path(TABLE_DIR, "MOFA2_training_sample_view_presence.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

if (sample_summary[n_views_present >= 2, .N] == 0) {
  stop("No samples are shared across at least two views. Please check sample IDs.")
}
```
```{r}
# Convert prepared matrices to MOFA2 long format

matrix_to_long <- function(mat, view_name) {
  dt <- as.data.table(as.table(mat))

  setnames(dt, c("feature", "sample", "value"))

  dt[
    ,
    `:=`(
      sample = as.character(sample),
      feature = as.character(feature),
      view = view_name,
      value = as.numeric(value)
    )
  ]

  dt[is.finite(value), .(sample, feature, view, value)]
}

mofa_dt <- rbindlist(
  lapply(names(view_mats), function(v) {
    matrix_to_long(view_mats[[v]], v)
  }),
  use.names = TRUE
)

mofa_dt <- mofa_dt[, .(sample, feature, view, value)]

mofa_dt

fwrite(
  mofa_dt,
  file.path(TABLE_DIR, "MOFA2_training_input_long_format.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

saveRDS(
  mofa_dt,
  file.path(RDS_DIR, "MOFA2_training_input_long_format.rds")
)
```
```{r}
# Create MOFA2 object

MOFAobject <- create_mofa(as.data.frame(mofa_dt))

MOFAobject

plot_data_overview(MOFAobject)

pdf(
  file.path(PLOT_DIR, "MOFA2_training_data_overview.pdf"),
  width = 8,
  height = 5
)
plot_data_overview(MOFAobject)
dev.off()
sample_summary[, .N, by = n_views_present][order(n_views_present)]
sample_summary
```

```{r}
# Define data, model, and training options

data_opts <- get_default_data_options(MOFAobject)

# Keep FALSE for mixed-likelihood model.
# RNA and CNV are Gaussian views, while mutation views are Bernoulli 0/1.
# Bernoulli views should remain binary.
data_opts$scale_views <- FALSE

model_opts <- get_default_model_options(MOFAobject)

model_opts$num_factors <- 6

# Assign likelihoods for each view.
view_likelihoods <- c(
  RNA_VST_top5000var = "gaussian",
  WES_CNV_numeric = "gaussian",
  WES_mutation_recurrent = "bernoulli",
  IMPACT_mutation_OncoKB = "bernoulli"
)

# Match likelihoods to the exact view order in the MOFA object.
mofa_views <- names(model_opts$likelihoods)

view_likelihoods <- view_likelihoods[mofa_views]

model_opts$likelihoods <- view_likelihoods

train_opts <- get_default_training_options(MOFAobject)

train_opts$convergence_mode <- "medium"
train_opts$maxiter <- 1000
train_opts$verbose <- TRUE
train_opts$seed <- 1

data_opts
model_opts
train_opts
```
```{r}
# Prepare MOFA2 object for training

MOFAobject <- prepare_mofa(
  object = MOFAobject,
  data_options = data_opts,
  model_options = model_opts,
  training_options = train_opts
)

MOFAobject
```
```{r}
# Train MOFA2 model

MOFAobject.trained <- run_mofa(
  object = MOFAobject,
  outfile = MODEL_OUTFILE,
  use_basilisk = TRUE
)

saveRDS(
  MOFAobject.trained,
  TRAINED_MODEL_RDS
)

MODEL_OUTFILE
TRAINED_MODEL_RDS
```
```{r}
# Final model overview

MOFAobject.trained

plot_data_overview(MOFAobject.trained)

pdf(
  file.path(PLOT_DIR, "MOFA2_trained_model_data_overview.pdf"),
  width = 8,
  height = 5
)
plot_data_overview(MOFAobject.trained)
dev.off()
```
```{r}
# Save final training summary

training_summary <- data.table(
  Metric = c(
    "Number of views used for training",
    "Views used for training",
    "Number of unique samples across all views",
    "Number of samples present in at least two views",
    "Number of factors requested",
    "Model output file",
    "Trained model RDS file"
  ),
  Value = c(
    length(view_mats),
    paste(names(view_mats), collapse = "; "),
    uniqueN(mofa_dt$sample),
    sample_summary[n_views_present >= 2, .N],
    model_opts$num_factors,
    MODEL_OUTFILE,
    TRAINED_MODEL_RDS
  )
)

training_summary

fwrite(
  training_summary,
  file.path(TABLE_DIR, "MOFA2_training_summary.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
```
